audit_items.proof_trace: The DELETE (L133) and INSERT (L138) are two separate Supabase/PostgREST HTTP calls with no wrapping database transaction. If the DELETE succeeds but the INSERT fails (e.g., constraint violation, transient error), the catch at L161 returns an error but does NOT roll back the DELETE, leaving the team permanently with zero leaders. A concurrent reader between the two calls also observes a transiently empty team_leaders state.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An admin calls updateTeamLeaders; the DELETE commits but the INSERT fails due to any error; all leader assignments for the team are permanently lost with no rollback path, causing data corruption requiring manual intervention.
